title: metadata-protocol: a refused package publish half-lands — every draft promoted before the refused item goes live, despite "没有内容生效 / nothing took effect"
body:
**Edition:** ObjectOS Cloud (os-test environment, reached over the MCP connection)
**Date seen:** 2026-11-11

## What happened

Package `app.nyd2` (app `leave_management` 「请假管理」) had 11 pending drafts, in this draft order:

1–5. view `nyd2_leave_request.leave_ledger` / `leave_month_ledger` / `leave_pending` / `leave_status_board` / `leave_calendar`
6. dataset `nyd2_leave_request_ds`
7. dashboard `leave_stats`
8. app `leave_management`
9. **object `nyd2_leave_request`** ← refused
10. permission `app_nyd2_member_access`
11. seed `nyd2_leave_request_sample`

Studio › 变更 › 全部发布 refused item 9:

> object 'nyd2_leave_request' · field 'leave_no' (autonumber "QJ{YYYYMM}-{0000}") — format interpolates `{YYYYMM}`, but object 'nyd2_leave_request' has no field named 'YYYYMM' — generation will always throw.

and the toast said:

> 未发布：1 项需要修改。… 没有内容生效：软件包作为一个整体发布，其余草稿会等待这项修复。

**But items 1–8 were published anyway.** Right after the refusal:

- the package's pending drafts dropped from 11 to **3** (object, permission, seed: exactly item 9 and everything after it);
- `describe_metadata(app, leave_management)` returns `_unpublished: false`;
- `verify_build` reports `appsLive: [{ name: "leave_management", live: true }]`, while every view probe fails with `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: Object 'nyd2_leave_request' not found`.

So the launcher now serves an app whose every nav entry opens a view on a table that does not exist.

## Expected

ADR-0067 D2 / the publish dialog's own text ("发布将一次性发布此包全部 11 个待发布草稿：要么全部生效，要么都不生效"): a refusal of any item rolls back every promotion in the batch, and nothing goes live.

## Why this looks like a rollback that covered nothing

`publishPackageDrafts` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`, Phase 1) promotes `ordered` drafts one by one inside `inTxn(...)` and rethrows on the first failure, expecting the engine transaction to roll back earlier promotions. The landed set is exactly the prefix of `ordered` before the failing item. That fits either:

- `engine.transaction` missing on this deployment's engine/driver, so `inTxn` falls through to a plain sequential run (the "weaker guarantee" branch), or
- the promote's repository writes not joining the ambient transaction (the #7880 shape), so the rollback covers nothing.

The outcome text is also wrong: the refusal path reports "nothing took effect" without checking that the rollback did anything.

Related, closed: #3066 (package-draft publish not turn-atomic: a commit CAN half-land), #7880 (ambient txStore rollback covers nothing).

## Secondary: the refusal was not visible before publish

The bad autonumber format was staged through MCP `create_metadata(type: object)` → `status: drafted` with no warning, and MCP `verify_build` then answered `errors: 0` ("structurally clean"). The `lint-autonumber-formats` rule is only enforced at publish. That is the save-vs-publish verdict parity #26707 / #26856 closed, but `verify_build` (and the create_metadata result) still do not surface it. After the half-landed publish, `verify_build` also said "every built app is live and reachable from the launcher — safe to tell the user the app is ready to open", although the app's only object is missing.

## Steps

1. Over MCP, create an app package with a few views/app drafts plus an object draft that has an autonumber field with `autonumberFormat: "QJ{YYYYMM}-{0000}"` (any unsupported `{TOKEN}`), with the object drafted **after** the views/app.
2. `verify_build` → 0 errors.
3. Studio › 变更 › 全部发布 → refused on the object, toast says nothing took effect.
4. `describe_metadata(app, …)` → `_unpublished: false`; the pending-draft count dropped to the object plus the drafts after it.
